assumptions: Key/value parsing splits on the first '=' only, so a value may itself contain '=' (e.g. KEY=a=b -> value 'a=b') — spec does not forbid this
A line with only 'export' (no following assignment) or an '=' with an empty key (e.g. '=value') is treated as a ParseProblem, since neither is a valid KEY=VALUE assignment
Comment detection checks the trimmed line's leading character for '#', so indented comments (e.g. '  # note') are still treated as comments
